exposure: Gestational weight gain (GWG) trajectories (non-rapid excessive weight gain, rapid excessive weight gain)
cohort: The study included 947 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who delivered in northern Taiwan between January 2012 and July 2022.
finding: Being pre-pregnancy underweight, having a normal or overweight/obese pre-pregnancy BMI, multiparity, and experiencing rapid excessive gestational weight gain were associated with an increased incidence of cesarean section in women with GDM.
mod_finding: Rapid excessive gestational weight gain, pre-pregnancy BMI (underweight, normal, overweight/obese), and multiparity were found to be significant predictors of cesarean section.
